notes: ACCESS: ashleyfurniture.com is behind PerimeterX. This session the curl_cffi mobile/desktop rotation held up throughout - safari18_0_ios, safari17_2_ios, safari18_0 and chrome131 all returned HTTP 200 server-rendered HTML and no page came back as a px-captcha, so the r.jina.ai relay recorded as the fallback in the Furniture pass was configured but only ever used once (on a dead node). robots.txt was fetched first: it explicitly Allows OAI-SearchBot / ChatGPT-User / GPTBot, has a 'User-Agent: *' group that disallows only account / cart / checkout / order / wishlist / compare style paths plus the facet params /*pmin, /*pmax and /*srule, blocks Pinterestbot and FacebookBot, and names NO anthropic-ai / ClaudeBot / Claude-Web agent. /c/ category paths are not disallowed. No Crawl-delay; probe.py's 2s per-host gap was used anyway and no 429 was seen. TREE: two independent sources, reconciled. (1) The server-rendered mega-menu present in every page's HTML (402 /c/ links) - its only Bathroom entry is 'Bath' under the Rugs & Decor column, pointing at /c/bathroom/all/. (2) The Bathroom department hub /c/bathroom/ itself (h1 'Bathroom Furniture & Decor'), whose own category tiles are the real child list: Vanities, Bathroom Storage, Fixtures & Hardware, Bathroom Lighting, Mirrors, and (inside the Storage module) Cabinets, Shelves, Organizers and Wastebaskets & Hampers. (3) Cross-checked against sitemap_7-category.xml (1,993 category URLs); every URL in it matching bath|bathroom|vanit|sink|basin|toilet|shower|towel|faucet|tap|sanitar|mirror was opened individually. Rows follow the hub's own tile order. QTY: every number is the storefront's own rendered listing header, the #product-results element (e.g. Bathroom Vanities '1 - 30 of 34 products'). For the four categories that hold fewer than one page (30) Ashley renders the short form '1 - N items' instead, and for those the qty was taken from that header AND independently confirmed by counting .product-tile nodes in the grid: Fixtures & Hardware 4/4, Shelves 3/3, Organizers 5/5, Trash Cans & Laundry Hampers 4/4. The second, mobile header (.mobile-product-count) agreed with #product-results on every bathroom node this session (34/34, 30/30, 37/37, 30/30, 4/4, 3/3, 5/5, 4/4), so the 1-2 unit drift the Furniture pass logged on some furniture categories did not occur here. VERIFICATION: (a) PAGINATION TO EXHAUSTION on every leaf over one page - Bathroom Vanities ?start=30&sz=30 renders '31 - 34 of 34 products' with exactly 4 tiles; Bathroom Storage ?start=30&sz=30 renders '31 - 37 of 37 products' with exactly 7 tiles; Bathroom Mirrors ?start=30&sz=30 renders '31 - 30 of 30 products' with 0 tiles (true end); Bathroom Cabinets ?start=30&sz=30 falls back to page one, i.e. 30 is the complete set. So none of these numbers is a display cap. (b) H1 AND BREADCRUMB were checked on every recorded page and match the node requested (e.g. cabinets -> h1 'Bathroom Cabinets', breadcrumb Home > Bathroom Furniture & Decor > Bathroom Storage > Bathroom Cabinets). (c) COUNTS DISCRIMINATE - 34/30/4/30/3/5/4 are all different, no site-wide constant. (d) CONTAINMENT CHECK on the Storage branch: the parent /c/bathroom/storage/ was enumerated over both its pages (36 distinct product titles for a 37 header - one title is carried by two SKUs) and the union of its four children's product titles is 34, every one of which is present in the parent set; the two parent-only items are 'Brayton Basket (Set of 2)' and 'Modway Render Tall Storage Cabinet'. The children overlap each other (the Linon Cleera 3 Shelf Bath Stand is in both Shelves and Organizers; the two Bayberry baskets and the HAPPIMESS hamper are in both Organizers and Wastebaskets & Hampers), so 30+3+5+4=42 deliberately does NOT sum to 37 - no quantity was aggregated anywhere and the Bathroom Storage grouping row carries a blank qty and blank link per rule 38/24. EXCLUDED - SHOP ALL / PROMO (rule 25): /c/bathroom/all/ (h1 'All Bathroom Accessories & Furniture', 196 products) is the department's Shop-All and is not recorded; its 196 is larger than the leaves because it also sweeps in the 38 Vanity-Lighting products that live in the Lighting department. Also excluded: /c/bathroom/deals/, /c/best-sellers/bathroom/ (8), /c/shop-by/new-arrivals/bathroom/, /c/deals/price-cuts/bathroom/, /c/deals/ready-to-ship/bathroom/, /c/deals/cottage-at-the-ridge/shop/bathroom/ and the two /sweepstakes/.../shop/bathroom/ pages. EXCLUDED - FACET URLS, NOT CATEGORIES: Ashley renders refinement values as path segments, so several bathroom-looking URLs are filters. /c/bathroom/storage/wall_storage/ is literally labelled 'Refine by Product Type: Wall Storage (3)' in the storage page's own refinement bar (its breadcrumb stops at Bathroom Storage and never gains a node of its own), as are /c/bathroom/storage/over_the_toilet/ (8), /over_the_door/ (3), /linen_cabinet/ (11), /medicine_cabinet/ (3), /storage_shelf/ (4) and the colour / material / brand / style / price variants, plus the whole /c/bathroom/all/<facet>/ family (vanity_lighting 38, single_sink 28, vanity 33, freestanding 9, double_sink 5, sconce 10, mirror 2 ...). None were recorded. EXCLUDED - SEO ALIASES (rule 28, one record per category): /c/bathroom-cabinets/, /c/bathroom-shelves/, /c/bathroom-laundry/ and /c/bathroom-fixtures/ are alternate URLs for categories already recorded - each returns the identical h1, the identical breadcrumb (e.g. /c/bathroom-cabinets/ -> Home > Bathroom Furniture & Decor > Bathroom Storage > Bathroom Cabinets) and the identical count (30 / 3 / 4 / 4). The hierarchical /c/bathroom/... URL was kept for each so the recorded tree matches the site's own breadcrumb; recording both would have double-counted. DEAD NODES (in the sitemap, 0 products, so nothing to record): /c/bathroom/towel-racks/, /c/bathroom/bath-towels/, /c/bathroom/accessories/, /c/bathroom/accessories/counter-organizers-decor/, /c/furniture/bathroom/shower-curtains/ and /c/bathroom-rugs/ all render Ashley's 'Product Search Results No Hits' page with zero .product-tile nodes. Towel racks and bath rugs are therefore not currently merchandised at all - had they carried stock, towel racks would have been Bathroom (rule 15/17) and bath rugs Textile (rule 16). EXCLUDED - OTHER DEPARTMENTS: /c/furniture/bedroom/makeup-vanities/ (28) is a Bedroom node - breadcrumb Home > Furniture > Bedroom Furniture > Makeup Vanities, and the products are bedroom dressing tables, not bathroom vanity units, so rule 29 disambiguation keeps it out of Bathroom. /c/home-decor/mirrors/ with its Wall Mirrors and Floor Mirrors children is the Home Decor mirror department, separate from the Bathroom Mirrors node that IS recorded. /c/furniture/large-spaces/bathroom/ (2) and /c/furniture/small-spaces/bathroom/ (2) are Furniture > Small/Large Space Furniture cross-cuts that re-list products already inside the Bathroom leaves. /c/furniture/bedroom/dressers/mirrored/ and /c/kids/furniture/kids-dressers/kids-dressers-and-mirrors/ are mirrored dressers (Bedroom / Kids). NOT SOLD: Ashley carries no sanitaryware line - no toilets, bidets, basins/sinks sold separately, bathtubs, showers, shower enclosures or bathroom taps/faucets appear anywhere in the category sitemap or in the Bathroom hub; the only 'sink' references are the single_sink / double_sink facets describing vanity sets. Nothing was omitted for being metal, glass or ceramic. || CROSS-FILE DEDUP: 1 leaf record(s) removed as already extracted in a prior category workbook. See Review sheet.
